title: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN with Saliency-Map Interpretability for Skin Cancer Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.37314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skin cancer is among the most prevalent and life threatening forms of cancer worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis significantly improves patient survival rates. However, manual dermoscopic assessment remains challenging due to visual similarity. This study proposes an Explainable AI-driven framework for automated binary classification of skin lesions using a lightweight attention-based convolutional neural network (CNN-Attention). The model integrates channel attention to focus on informative regions of dermoscopic images while maintaining low computational complexity. A publicly available dataset comprising 2,637 training and 660 test images was used, with balanced class weights. The proposed model achieved 87 percent accuracy with 1.95 million parameters and 7.45 MB of storage, matching the best baseline (MobileNet) while using approximately half as many parameters and half as much storage. ROC AUC and PR AUC scores reached 0.9475

translated_title: 一种基于轻量级注意力机制、具有显著性图可解释性的皮肤癌检测卷积神经网络
translated_abstract: 皮肤癌是全球最常见且最致命的癌症之一，早期准确诊断可显著提高患者的生存率。然而，由于皮肤病变在视觉上的相似性，人工皮肤镜评估仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种由可解释人工智能驱动的框架，利用轻量级的基于注意力的卷积神经网络对皮肤病变进行自动二分类。该模型集成了通道注意力机制，以聚焦于皮肤镜图像中信息丰富的区域，同时保持较低的计算复杂度。研究使用了一个包含2637张训练图像和660张测试图像的公开数据集，并采用平衡的类别权重。所提出的模型仅用195万个参数和7.45 MB的存储空间就达到了87%的准确率，与最佳基线模型相当，而其参数量和存储空间仅约为后者的一半。ROC AUC和PR AUC分数达到了0.9475。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种带有显著性图可解释性的轻量级注意力CNN用于皮肤癌检测，仅用约一半的参数量和存储空间就达到了与MobileNet相当的87%准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight attention-based CNN with saliency-map interpretability for skin cancer detection, achieving 87% accuracy comparable to MobileNet while using only about half the parameters and storage.
